Welcome to Skibidi Masters Tower Defense! 🚽⚔️
Defend your base against relentless waves, summon legendary units, and team up with friends to become the ultimate Master!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🤔 STEP on a platform, select a stage, and start the match!
⚔️ PLACE towers to fight off enemies!
💰 EARN cash to upgrade your units mid-battle!
⭐ SUMMON rare characters and build your dream team!

👍 LIKE and FAVORITE the game for more updates!
🎁 NEW CODE unlocks at 175,000 LIKES!
💎 Use Codes: FREETRAIT, POTIONS, TRADEPLAZA, 50MVISITS
